said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

My office and I are closely monitoring the nationwide ground stop.

The Trump Administration must answer for this disruption. The American people deserve a full explanation, and Congress must be immediately briefed on what went wrong and who is responsible. https://t.co/c30uwdCE9G

Today, I'm proud to announce that we have finally passed the Major Richard Star Act to make sure our combat-injured veterans are not denied any of the benefits they have rightfully earned. 

I urged my colleagues to get this bill across the finish line earlier today. https://t.co/tTUIWUVqZK
Nobody is coming after our service members. We're coming after you for your reckless actions and dangerous incompetence. https://t.co/kGfZ0Vsp9o

Trump is at it again. 

No evidence. Just loser behavior. https://t.co/BpgUsreVqZ

It's Election Day, which means it's time to exercise your sacred right to vote. 

Polls in New Jersey are open until 8 pm tonight. 

Find your polling location here: https://t.co/f5HW1bPeU5

Donald Trump's war with Iran has cost us over $47 billion, and what has it gotten us?

Fallen service members, higher prices for Americans, and depleted weapons stock.

https://t.co/UqcWcVHXT6

Today we lost a civil rights trailblazer and labor union champion, Dolores Huerta. 

Let us honor her memory by continuing the fight for racial and economic justice; the same fight she dedicated her life’s work to. May she rest in peace.
